| monster-body:antaeus | <br>Once a hero among the titans, Antaeus grew jealous of the titan queen. In<br>single combat he challenged and slew her, and for this crime he was exiled and<br>descended into the Hells. Finding the inhabitants of that place no match for his<br>might, Antaeus tore from its substance a fourth Hell, Cocytus, a realm born of<br>frozen spite. | <br>安泰俄斯曾经是泰坦中的英雄，但他嫉妒泰坦女王。<br>他向女王发起一对一的决斗挑战，并杀死了她，因此随后被流放到了地狱。<br>安泰俄斯发现栖息在那个地方的生灵无法与他匹敌，<br>于是他从地狱的本体中撕裂出第四座地狱——悲叹河，一个由冰冷怨恨凝成的领域。 | adjust | 泰坦英雄嫉妒女王、杀人被放逐、撕出第四Hell和冰冷怨恨均保留；single combat单挑范围遗漏。 MON-003 已修复：补一对一决斗/单挑，不把女王之死泛化为某场战斗。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:arachne | <br>Once a talented human weaver, Arachne was transformed into a monstrous<br>half-spider by a jealous rival's curse. Driven out of her village, she found<br>sanctuary for a time among the jorogumo before a bitter feud forced her to<br>flee once more.<br><br>Now she wanders other corners of the dungeon with a small retinue of loyal<br>students in tow, seeking a new domain in which they can spin their peerless<br>tapestries in peace. | <br>阿拉克涅曾是一位才华横溢的人类织工，却被嫉妒的对手诅咒，<br>变成了可怖的半蜘蛛怪物。被逐出村庄后，她一度在络新妇中找到庇护，<br>但一场激烈争斗又迫使她逃亡。<br><br>如今，她带着一小群忠诚学生游荡在地牢的其他角落，<br>寻找一片能让众人安静织造无双锦绣的新领地。 | keep | 人类织工被嫉妒者诅咒半蛛、遭逐、受络新妇庇护再因争斗逃亡、忠学生寻和平织锦地齐全，两段未漏。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. Help usesEnglish enum key and filter; no assertion of random spawnfrequency." 名称/标题关联：[{"en": "Arachne", "identity": "monster:MONS_ARACHNE", "unique_title": "被放逐的阿拉克涅\n", "zh": "阿拉克涅"}] 生命周期：current definition; ordinary/help/internal according to snapshot flags | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monsters.txt:36；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monsters.txt:32；{"boundary": "Per-identity EN/ZH propositions read above; YAMLcore facts and selected book/producer evidence below. | monster-body:arcanist | <br>A wizard fond of spectacle and destruction. They scorn the cowardice of other<br>magicians, who hide from their foes rather than simply blasting them out of<br>existence. | <br>一个喜欢精彩场面和破坏的巫师。<br>这名巫师蔑视那些躲着敌人、而不是随手将其炸飞的懦弱的魔法师。 | keep | 喜毁灭、鄙视其他躲敌法师、直接炸杀的性格齐全；they译此法师避免误复数。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:armour echo | <br>The sweat and toil of the armourer working leather and steel infuses an<br>intention into their creation, a unique spark within every cuirass, pauldron and<br>vambrace. A skilled forgewright can manifest these intentions in physical form,<br>allowing their armour to protect its wearer in a more aggressive fashion than<br>armour customarily does. | <br>军械士加工皮革与钢铁时付出的汗水和辛劳，会为造物注入意念，<br>在每件胸甲、护肩和臂甲中留下独特火花。技艺高超的铸甲师能让这些<br>意念具现，使防具以远比通常更具攻击性的方式保护穿戴者。 | keep | 制作皮钢防具者注意念、各护件火花、术者具现攻击性保护齐全；forgewright铸甲师指称待背景组共享证据。 MON-019 Suggestion保留：制作皮钢防具者注意念、各护件火花、术者具现攻击性保护齐全；forgewright铸甲师指称待背景组共享证据。 此次仅建议，不强制改风格或在缺上下文时定错。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. Help usesEnglish enum key and filter; no assertion of random spawnfrequency." 名称/标题关联：[{"en": "armour echo", "identity": "monster:MONS_ARMOUR_ECHO", "unique_title": null, "zh": "铠甲回响"}] 生命周期：current definition; ordinary/help/internal according to snapshot flags | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monsters.txt:738；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monsters.txt:593；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monsters.txt:737；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monsters.txt:592；{"boundary": "Per-identity EN/ZH propositions read above; YAMLcore facts and selected book/producer evidence below. | monster-body:asmodeus | <br>Greatest and most cunning of the Lords of Hell, Asmodeus was born when the twin<br>fires of greed and treachery first sparked to life within a mortal's heart.<br>His hideous body is perpetually wreathed in flame. | <br>作为最伟大、最狡猾的地狱领主，<br>阿斯摩蒂斯诞生于贪婪和背叛的双生之火第一次在凡人的心中燃起之时。<br>他那狰狞的身躯永远被火焰包围着。 | keep | 最大最狡猾Hell领主、凡人贪婪背叛初火所生、永燃身躯齐全，专名不靠长名keep推导。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:aspiring flesh | <br>The divided and churning remains of a protean progenitor, striving desperately<br>for form. Whatever they become, the last of their progenitor's power ensure it<br>will be stronger and swifter than any such creature found elsewhere in the<br>dungeon. | <br>一个变形之祖的分裂、搅动的遗骸，竭力变化着形态。无论它们变成什么，<br>它们祖先的最后力量将确保它比任何在地牢其他地方碰到的那种生物更强、更快。 | keep | 变形之祖分裂遗骸追求形态及产物更强更快齐全；中文数量指代略生硬，需目标增强实现证据。 MON-020 Suggestion保留：变形之祖分裂遗骸追求形态及产物更强更快齐全；中文数量指代略生硬，需目标增强实现证据。 此次仅建议，不强制改风格或在缺上下文时定错。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:assassin centipede monster | <br>An oversized insect with dagger-sharp forcipules and a great abundance of limbs.<br>Its sting injects crippling toxins whose potency increases as they mature. | <br>一只巨大的昆虫，毒颚如匕首般锋利，肢足多得惊人。<br>它的蜇刺会注入令人衰弱的毒素，随着它长大，毒素的效力也会增强。 | adjust | 毒颚多足和衰弱毒素齐全，但成熟被接到毒素；当前按怪物经验等级升级毒性。 MON-004 已修复：根据mon-util.cc:2131–2141按怪物经验等级升级毒性，改“随着它长大，毒液也会变得更强”。 生产入口："mon-info.cc:1092-1104; mon-util.cc:2131-2141" 生命周期：current derived key | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monsters.txt:754；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monsters.txt:3709；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monsters.txt:753；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monsters.txt:3708；{"boundary": "Per-identity EN/ZH propositions read above; YAMLcore facts and selected book/producer evidence below. | monster-body:asterion | <br>Once a king infamous for waging bloodthirsty campaigns, Asterion was exiled to<br>the depths of the dungeon for his crimes. Here he lurks in his tattered finery,<br>dreaming of a new kingdom. In his lust for power, the minotaur king turned to<br>the worship of Makhleb, and Makhleb has rewarded him with horrifying<br>destructive might. | <br>阿斯忒里翁曾经是一个国王，因发动了残酷的战争而臭名昭著，<br>后来因为他的罪行被流放地牢的地底。<br>他穿着破旧的华服潜伏在这里，梦想建立新的王国。<br>这个牛头人王出于对力量的渴望，转而皈依马科列布，<br>而马科列布也赐予他骇人的毁灭性力量。 | keep | 血战恶名之王被逐地牢、破华服梦想新国、信马科列布求力并获毁灭力齐全。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. Help usesEnglish enum key and filter; no assertion of random spawnfrequency." 名称/标题关联：[{"en": "Asterion", "identity": "monster:MONS_ASTERION", "unique_title": "堕落之王阿斯忒里翁\n", "zh": "阿斯忒里翁"}] 生命周期：current definition; ordinary/help/internal according to snapshot flags | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monsters.txt:53；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monsters.txt:47；{"boundary": "Per-identity EN/ZH propositions read above; YAMLcore facts and selected book/producer evidence below. | monster-body:bag of meat | <br>One of the legions of abominations created by the sculptors of flesh. It is a<br>horrendous imitation of the human form, consisting of an unrecognisable mass of<br>meat stitched together with limbs sewn on seemingly at random. Its skin hangs<br>off loosely in some places and bulges repulsively in others. Each one bears a<br>large symbol carved into its flesh, a mark of pride from its twisted creator. | <br>由肉雕师制造的憎恶军团中的一员。<br>这是一件可怕的人形仿制品，由一大堆无法辨认的肉连在一起，<br>肢体似乎随意缝在上面。在有些地方它的皮肤松弛下垂，有些地方则臃肿地隆起。<br>每个都有着一个刻在其肉里的巨大符号，这是其性格扭曲的创造者的骄傲的象征。 | defer implementation | 肉雕师造物、随缝肢体、皮肤松垂/隆起、骄傲刻印齐全；憎恶是描述性造物非强制链接abomination枚举。 生产入口：{"judgment": "Matchingname:/n_adj/n_rpl affects display only; withoutdbname: it does not select thisTextDBbody. | monster-body:bai suzhen | <br>A weary draconian with foreign and watery scales. She has come to the Dungeon<br>in hopes of resurrecting her mortal husband; a noble cause, for a being once<br>known for quarrelling with saints and flooding unfortunate temples. If pressed<br>to her limits, she will reveal her true form, the mere sight of which struck<br>her husband dead. Adventurers may wish they were so lucky! | <br>一个疲惫的龙人，长有异样的似水的鳞片。<br>她来到地牢是为了一项崇高的事情，希望能找到复活她的凡人夫君的方法，<br>但她也因与和尚斗法而淹没不幸的佛寺而闻名。<br>如果把她逼得走投无路，她会展现出自己的真实形态，<br>她的丈夫仅仅只是看到就被吓死了。冒险者可能会希望他们也能这么幸运！ | keep | 疲惫水鳞龙人、复夫崇高目的对比斗圣淹寺往事、逼至真形曾吓死夫及冒险者求同幸运反讽齐全；两形态共用。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. Help usesEnglish enum key and filter; no assertion of random spawnfrequency." 名称/标题关联：[{"en": "Bai Suzhen", "identity": "monster:MONS_BAI_SUZHEN", "unique_title": "白素贞，白蛇夫人\n", "zh": "白素贞"}, {"en": "Bai Suzhen", "identity": "monster:MONS_BAI_SUZHEN_DRAGON", "unique_title": "白素贞，白蛇夫人\n", "zh": "白素贞"}] 生命周期：current definition; ordinary/help/internal according to snapshot flags | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monsters.txt:65；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monsters.txt:59；{"boundary": "Per-identity EN/ZH propositions read above; YAMLcore facts and selected book/producer evidence below. | monster-body:blorkula the orcula | <br>Once a gangly and bedraggled vampire with a strange obsession with colour,<br>Blorkula was offered succour by a missionary of Beogh and became a portly and<br>vigorous orc with a strange obsession with colour instead.<br><br>He wields magic tinged with every hue of the rainbow, and has mastered the art<br>of dividing his own form among its many colours to avoid killing blows - though<br>even he must rest a while before doing so a second time. | <br>曾经是一个瘦长而邋遢的吸血鬼，对颜色有着奇怪的痴迷，<br>布洛库拉被一位比欧弗传教士所救助，变成了一个圆胖而精力充沛的兽人，<br>仍然对颜色有着奇怪的痴迷。<br><br>他运用染上彩虹每种色调的魔法，并精通将自己的形态分散到众多颜色中<br>以避免致命一击的艺术——尽管即使是他也必须在再次使用前稍作休息。 | keep | 吸血鬼变精壮圆胖兽人、颜色执念、比欧弗使徒救助、虹色分身避致命击及再用须休息齐全。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:boris | <br>An ancient and powerful lich. | monster-body:boundless tesseract | <br>An impossible shape that scintillates with unearthly colour. The power of Zot<br>flows heavily through it, overlaying this reality with countless others where<br>its domain remains pristine.<br><br>Each tesseract is inextricably linked to the other, and destroying one will<br>destroy both (and expel all the creatures they have beckoned to this reality,<br>as well as dazing even those which they have not). But so long as they are<br>allowed to exist, there will be no end to the forces which seek to keep you from<br>the Orb. | <br>一个闪烁着超自然色彩的不可能形状。强大的佐特之力流经其中，<br>将此现实与无数个佐特领域仍完好如初的现实叠合在一起。<br><br>两个超立方体彼此紧密相连，摧毁其中一个就会同时摧毁两者，<br>并驱逐它们召来此现实的所有生物；即使不是由它们召来的生物，也会陷入眩晕。<br>但只要任由它们存在，阻止你取得宝珠的力量就会源源不绝。 | keep | 不可能几何、Zot叠无数现实、两体联毁及驱逐召来者/眩晕其他者、存续则无尽护Orb兵力全部保留两段。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. Help usesEnglish enum key and filter; no assertion of random spawnfrequency." 名称/标题关联：[{"en": "boundless tesseract", "identity": "monster:MONS_BOUNDLESS_TESSERACT", "unique_title": null, "zh": "无界超立方体"}] 生命周期：current definition; ordinary/help/internal according to snapshot flags | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monsters.txt:908；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monsters.txt:3177；{"boundary": "Per-identity EN/ZH propositions read above; YAMLcore facts and selected book/producer evidence below. | monster-body:cassandra | <br>As a young woman, Cassandra bound herself in service to Ashenzari and was<br>blessed and cursed in equal measure - granted the ability to foresee disasters,<br>but only those she was powerless to prevent.<br><br>Eventually driven from her homeland as a harbinger of the very plagues she'd<br>spent a lifetime warning against, she has come to the dungeon in her final days<br>in hope of averting one last catastrophe. | <br>年轻时，卡珊德拉以枷锁束缚自己，侍奉艾申扎利，受到的祝福与诅咒同样深重——<br>被赋予了预见灾难的能力，但仅限于那些她无力阻止的灾难。<br><br>最终，作为她毕生警告的瘟疫的预兆者被驱逐出故乡，<br>她在最后的日子里来到地牢，希望阻止最后一场大灾变。 | adjust | 预灾却无力阻止、因瘟疫预言被逐、暮年来避最后大灾均保留；Ashenzari当前译名出现不一致阿申扎里。 MON-010 已修复：当前神祇同一身份的显示名为艾申扎利；同步字形且自然写侍奉/以枷锁束缚自己，勿仅凭旧表keep。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:dispater | <br>Greatest and most ruthless of the Lords of Hell, Dispater was born when first an<br>iron sword drank mortal blood. | monster-body:dissolution | <br>The Pits of Slime used to be a thriving civilisation, and Dissolution was the<br>prophet of their god. When the city was overtaken by its current residents,<br>only Dissolution survived, for they alone turned faithfully to the Slime God.<br>Dissolution became a tremendous mass of acidic ooze, yet retained their<br>intelligence. They are filled with hatred for anything that can hold a form. | <br>史莱姆之坑曾孕育过繁荣的文明，分解者则是当地居民所信奉之神的先知。<br>当这座城市被如今的居民占据时，只有分解者幸存，<br>因为唯有分解者虔诚地转而信奉了黏液神。<br>分解者已变成一大团酸性软泥，却仍保有心智，<br>对一切能够维持固定形态的事物充满憎恨。 | keep | Slime繁荣文明与旧神先知、仅此虔信黏液神幸存、变酸泥仍理智、恨固定形体齐全。Pits of Slime为branch长名，不拿多个既有短译机械判错。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. Help usesEnglish enum key and filter; no assertion of random spawnfrequency." 名称/标题关联：[{"en": "Dissolution", "identity": "monster:MONS_DISSOLUTION", "unique_title": "分解者，吉瓦的高级祭司\n", "zh": "分解者"}] 生命周期：current definition; ordinary/help/internal according to snapshot flags | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monsters.txt:122；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monsters.txt:95；{"boundary": "Per-identity EN/ZH propositions read above; YAMLcore facts and selected book/producer evidence below. | monster-body:edmund | <br>A jealous sibling of Sigmund (indeed, the youngest of nine brothers). He has<br>none of Sigmund's skills in magic, but makes up for it with his skills in<br>fighting and a canny head for money. He is eager to prove his superiority by<br>killing hapless adventurers with his expensive flail and quick wit. | <br>西格蒙德一个好嫉妒的弟弟（他是九兄弟中最小的一个）。<br>他丝毫不通西格蒙德的魔法，却靠格斗技巧和精于钱财的头脑弥补了不足。<br>他急于用昂贵的链枷与敏捷的机智杀死倒霉的冒险者，以此证明自己胜过哥哥。 | adjust | Sigmund九兄最幼嫉兄、无魔靠战斗聪明、贵连枷杀冒险者证明优越齐全，但理财专长与quick wit被丢/改诡计。 MON-052 已修复：保留善算钱财、敏捷机智及胜过哥哥的证明，勿删财务目标或把quick wit变诡计。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:ereshkigal | <br>Greatest and most inexorable of the Lords of Hell, Ereshkigal was born when<br>first a mortal breathed her last. | monster-body:erythrospite | <br>A churning mass of flowing blood that throbs to the beat of an absent heart.<br><br>Does it wish to bury itself in your arteries because it recognises, on some<br>primordial level, that this is where it belongs? | monster-body:frances | <br>A stout warrior who once bested a powerful lord of Pandemonium in combat,<br>gaining control over the demon's realm and thanes. | monster-body:goblin | <br>A short, impatient and unfriendly humanoid. Goblins first appeared only a few<br>years ago, but are now remarkably numerous. Sadly, no number of raucous goblin<br>parties will put them in a welcoming mood toward adventurers. | <br>一个矮小、急躁、不友好的人形生物。地精在几年前才开始出现，但现在数量惊人。<br>遗憾的是，无论举办多少场喧闹的地精派对，也无法让它们对冒险者友善起来。 | keep | 矮躁不友好、仅几年前出现现数量多、再多喧派也不迎冒险者齐全。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:goblin rider | <br>Goblin clans fractured over the advent of steel exoskeletons long ago, prompting<br>an experimental arms race for goblin hegemony. Some volunteered to join forces<br>with other species, an alliance that has enabled capturing and taming wyverns.<br>From uptop their majestic dragon-like mounts, these goblins swiftly soar about<br>and skewer those who intrude upon their allies' domain. | <br>地精氏族在许久以前因钢铁外骨骼的出现而分裂，引发了一场争夺地精<br>霸权的实验性军备竞赛。一些地精自愿与其他物种结盟，<br>这种联盟使得捕捉和驯服双足飞龙成为可能。从它们雄伟的龙形坐骑上，<br>这些地精迅速飞翔并用矛刺穿闯入其盟友领地的人。 | keep | 地精钢外骨骼分裂引军备争霸、异种联盟驯飞龙、龙骑飞刺盟地入侵者齐全；long ago与goblin几年前出现潜在源文时序需记EN债而不误判ZH。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. Help usesEnglish enum key and filter; no assertion of random spawnfrequency." 名称/标题关联：[{"en": "goblin rider", "identity": "monster:MONS_GOBLIN_RIDER", "unique_title": null, "zh": "地精骑手"}] 生命周期：current definition; ordinary/help/internal according to snapshot flags | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monsters.txt:1682；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monsters.txt:3297；{"boundary": "Per-identity EN/ZH propositions read above; YAMLcore facts and selected book/producer evidence below. | monster-body:goji | <br>An intrepid goblin who has somehow managed to tame a ghost moth as his mount.<br>While the elaborate snarl of ropes he is using to remain upright on it surely<br>undermines the moth's own mobility, even a hobbled ghost moth can be a deadly<br>adversary.<br><br>And Goji? Well. He's also here. | <br>一个胆大无畏的地精，不知怎么驯服了一只幽灵蛾当坐骑。<br>为了稳稳骑在蛾背上，他用了错综复杂的一团绳索，这无疑妨碍了蛾的行动；<br>但即使行动受限，幽灵蛾依然可能是致命的对手。<br><br>至于戈吉？嗯。他也在这里。 | keep | 地精驯ghost moth、绑绳碍蛾仍致命、地精也在的自嘲两段齐全；骑乘/落地两实体共用。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:grunn | <br>A brutally twisted undead gnoll in the eternal service of Ereshkigal, lord of<br>Tartarus. Legend has it that he sold his soul to return his most beloved hunting<br>dog to life. Whether that hound is a member of his current pack, none can say. | <br>一个残忍扭曲的豺狼人亡灵，永远为塔尔塔罗斯的领主埃列什基伽勒服务。<br>传说他出卖了自己的灵魂，为了让他最心爱的猎犬得以复活。<br>这只猎狗是否属于他现在的群落，谁也说不准。 | keep | 扭曲亡灵gnoll永侍Eresh/Tartarus、卖魂救爱犬、是否现pack未知传说齐全；群落可更明确犬群建议。 MON-075 Suggestion保留：扭曲亡灵gnoll永侍Eresh/Tartarus、卖魂救爱犬、是否现pack未知传说齐全；群落可更明确犬群建议。 此为非必改自然度/文学/清晰度建议，不按偏好升级。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:guardian serpent | <br>A rare and distinct member of scaly society, light and swift like a snake, yet<br>also intelligent like a naga. It is said that a guardian serpent would rather<br>die in battle than leave anything to an intruder. | <br>它是有鳞生物中稀有而独特成员，既像蛇一样轻快，又有与纳迦一样的智力。<br>据说，守护蛇宁可战死，也不会给入侵者留下任何东西。 | keep | 罕有有鳞社会成员蛇轻快naga聪明、宁死不让入侵者夺物齐全；留下任何东西可明确保护财物而非遗物。 MON-076 Suggestion保留：罕有有鳞社会成员蛇轻快naga聪明、宁死不让入侵者夺物齐全；留下任何东西可明确保护财物而非遗物。 此为非必改自然度/文学/清晰度建议，不按偏好升级。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:hexer | <br>A humanoid construct of insubstantial memory, floating through the air. Though<br>perhaps somewhat changed in shape and bearing few discernable features, still<br>it seems somehow to resemble a warrior from the distantly remembered past,<br>ready with debilitating spells and deadly knifework. | <br>一个由虚幻记忆构成的人形造物，浮在空中。<br>尽管形貌或许与记忆中略有不同，也没什么明显可辨的特征，<br>但它仍像一位来自记忆深处、遥远往昔的战士，准备着衰弱法术和致命的刀法。 | adjust | 祖先虚记忆浮人、模糊特征战士用衰弱咒刀齐全；perhaps changed形貌已异却译未来会变形，可能误添变形能力。 MON-078 已修复：原文是或许与遥远记忆中的身形略有差别，现“外形会发生变化”改为未来必然变化并漏perhaps。改“虽然形貌或许与记忆中略有不同”；这是时间/模态命题，不声称所有玩家必会误判成反复变形。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:hydra | <br>A great and nightmarish lacertilian beast. It has many heads, and the potential<br>to grow many more!<br><br>Hitting it with any bladed weapon bigger than a short blade risks lopping a<br>head off and causing two more to grow in its place. Very large claws, such as<br>trolls', are long enough to do the same. Only a weapon branded with flame will<br>cauterise the wound and prevent more heads from growing. | <br>一头噩梦般的巨型蜥蜴类怪兽。它有很多个头，而且可能还会长出更多！<br><br>用任何比短刃更大的有刃武器击打它，有可能会砍掉一个头部，<br>但却会导致其位置上长出另外两个头。<br>用巨大的爪子进行攻击，比如巨魔的爪子，也会因足够长，导致产生同样的情况。<br>只有用带有火焰印记的武器才能灼烧伤口并防止长出更多的头。 | keep | 多头可增、长于短刃刀斩头一生二、大爪同效、只火焰武器焦口止生齐全；实际cut/cauterise条件待核，未因英文宽泛直接改玩家规则。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:ignacio | <br>While a mortal cannot turn into a demon aside from divine intervention, this is<br>what happened to Ignacio after Makhleb saw his love for his job and smiled upon<br>him. He is now slated to continue the joy of his life for all eternity.<br><br>Although his new form includes a number of large razor-sharp blades growing<br>from his demonic appendages, he kept his favourite axe and is eager to let you<br>test its edge. | <br>若是没有神明的介入，凡人是不可能变为恶魔的。<br>当马科列布看到伊格纳西奥对他的工作的热爱并对他微笑后，<br>伊格纳西奥身上就发生了这样的事情。现在他将永远继续他一生的乐趣了。<br><br>尽管他的新形态有着从恶魔附肢长出的大量锋利的刀片，<br>但他还是保留了他最喜欢的斧头，并想用你来测试它的锋利程度。 | adjust | 唯神干预凡人成魔、Makhleb爱其工作赐永乐、魔附大刃但保宠斧试玩家齐全；同段伊格纳西欧/伊格纳西奥不一致。 MON-080 已修复：同一段已用伊格纳西奥且当前显示/称号也同，统一姓名。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:inugami | <br>A mystical canine, frequently bound into the service of wizards and sorcerers.<br>Its eyes flicker with remarkable intelligence, but its bite is no less sharp<br>than its wilder cousins.<br><br>They are difficult to truly kill - when gravely wounded, they instead return to<br>spiritual form to lick their wounds until ready to be summoned again. | <br>一只神秘的犬科动物，经常为巫师和术师服务。<br>它的眼睛闪烁着非凡的智慧，它的咬伤也不比它更狂野的表亲逊色。<br><br>它们很难被真正杀死——<br>当受到重伤时，它们会回到灵体形态舔舐伤口，直到准备好再次响应召唤。 | keep | 神秘犬常被法师束仆、智眼利咬、难真杀重伤回灵舔伤待再召齐全；bound可更明确约束非自愿，They指群犬合理。 MON-087 Suggestion保留：神秘犬常被法师束仆、智眼利咬、难真杀重伤回灵舔伤待再召齐全；bound可更明确约束非自愿，They指群犬合理。 本条仅清晰度/词义边缘建议，不强判当前叙事错误。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:jeremiah | <br>Jeremiah was a peaceful dreamer, prone to impromptu naps. They slipped into<br>slumber while gazing into a magical orb, and dreamed of an old and hateful<br>power binding them into service. Now Jeremiah stumbles through the dungeon,<br>searching for the precious dreamshard that will restore their master’s power,<br>unsure whether they wake or slumber still. Their dreams leak into reality in<br>the form of a constant stream of butterflies. | <br>耶利米曾是个爱好和平的梦想家，时常随兴打盹。<br>一次凝视魔法宝珠时，耶利米陷入沉睡，梦见一股古老而充满怨恨的力量将自己束缚，迫其效劳。<br>如今耶利米在地牢中踉跄前行，寻找能恢复主人力量的珍贵梦境碎片，<br>却不确定自己究竟醒着，还是仍在梦中。其梦境化作源源不断的蝴蝶，渗入现实。 | keep | 和平爱睡dreamer宝珠梦古恨力缚役、踉跄寻梦碎片复主不知醒梦、梦蝶不断外溢齐全。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:knight | <br>A humanoid construct of insubstantial memory, floating through the air. Though<br>perhaps somewhat changed in shape and bearing few discernable features, still<br>it seems somehow to resemble a warrior from the distantly remembered past,<br>well equipped with arms and armour both. | <br>一个由虚幻记忆构成的人形造物，浮在空中。<br>尽管形貌或许与记忆中略有不同，也没什么明显可辨的特征，<br>但它仍像一位来自记忆深处、遥远往昔的战士，装备着精良的武器和盔甲。 | adjust | 祖先虚记忆武甲战士齐全；与hexer同源perhaps已改形貌却译会发生变化，须恢复过去或记忆差异的不确定。 MON-083 已修复：与hexer同根：将或许与旧记忆略有差别改成“外形会发生变化”，时间/模态丢失。改“虽然形貌或许与记忆中略有不同”；不夸称它会反复变形。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:lernaean hydra | <br>A huge beast, mightiest of hydras, infamous in myth and legend. It flows<br>through the water faster than a human can run, swatting aside trees as though<br>they were matchsticks. Its many heads slaver and gnash constantly as it hunts<br>for prey to slake its bottomless appetite. | <br>这头身形庞大的野兽，是多头蛇中的最强者，在传说和神话中臭名昭著。<br>它在水中游动的速度比人类跑得快，游动时会将树拍到一边，仿佛它们是火柴杆。<br>它的许多头在不断地淌着口水、磨着牙，想要捕获猎物，以满足其无尽的食欲。 | keep | 最强神话大hydra水速超人跑、拨树如火柴、诸头流涎磨牙饥渴无底齐全；特例水速/砍树待code。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:lodul | <br>An ogre emissary of the Ironbound Order, sent to find and stop intruders before<br>they enter the Vaults. Fiercely charismatic, he's rallied a small army of his<br>kin, overawing them with the long-range lightning array he wears on his back.<br>(The large coin purse he took from the Vaults is also quite persuasive.) | <br>一个铁缚会的食人魔使者，被派去追踪并阻止入侵者进入宝库。<br>他极具个人魅力，召集了一小群由同族组成的军队，<br>并凭借其背上的远程闪电阵震慑住了他们。<br>（他从宝库里拿走的一大笔钱也很有说服力。） | keep | Ironbound派ogre阻敌进Vaults、魅力召同族军、背远电威慑兼钱袋招募笑话齐全；铁缚会/团后缀可统一建议。 MON-101 Suggestion保留：Ironbound派ogre阻敌进Vaults、魅力召同族军、背远电威慑兼钱袋招募笑话齐全；铁缚会/团后缀可统一建议。 可接受表达的明确化/自然度建议，非必改。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:lom lobon | <br>Stoic and inscrutable, Lom Lobon is an ancient demon infamous for their mastery<br>of magic. Rumoured to be the most learned being in the halls of Pandemonium,<br>they are at times sought out by mortal wizards who offer their souls in<br>exchange for the secrets of the arcane. Lacking the terrible wrath present in<br>most demons, Lom Lobon's single eye instead hides a cold, impartial cruelty. | <br>洛姆·洛邦是一个以精通魔法而臭名昭著的古老恶魔，他坚忍而高深莫测。<br>据传他是万魔殿中最博学的存在，有时凡人巫师会寻找到他，<br>要用自己的灵魂交换其奥术秘密。<br>洛姆·洛邦的独眼没有大多数恶魔身上那种可怕的愤怒，<br>反而隐现着一种冷酷、无差别的残忍。 | keep | 古Stoic难测魔法Pan博学主、凡人以魂换秘、不易怒但冷酷无差别齐全，they单他符合身份。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. Help usesEnglish enum key and filter; no assertion of random spawnfrequency." 名称/标题关联：[{"en": "Lom Lobon", "identity": "monster:MONS_LOM_LOBON", "unique_title": "洛姆·洛邦，禁忌知识之恶魔领主\n", "zh": "洛姆·洛邦"}] 生命周期：current definition; ordinary/help/internal according to snapshot flags | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monsters.txt:344；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monsters.txt:295；{"boundary": "Per-identity EN/ZH propositions read above; YAMLcore facts and selected book/producer evidence below. | monster-body:lost soul | <br>The echo of an unmourned soul. Though the memories of its living self are<br>long-faded, it is drawn to the moment of death by some lingering instinct. It<br>seizes upon the passage of other souls, losing the last vestiges of its being<br>in the memories of another's life. | <br>一个无人哀悼的灵魂的回音。尽管它自己生前的记忆已经褪去很久了，<br>但还是被某种弥留的本能拉到了死亡的那一刻。<br>它攫住其他灵魂离去的时刻，并在另一段人生的记忆中耗尽自身最后的残痕。 | keep | 无人哀魂回音、失生记忆本能趋死亡、借另一生魂过境而尽自身齐全。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:louise | <br>A mighty sorceress, clad from head to toe in heavy armour. Once an adventurer<br>looking for the fabled Orb of Zot, she was cast into the Abyss and got<br>hopelessly lost there. Toyed with by some greater power, she was stuck on the<br>hostile plane for nearly a decade. When she finally emerged from the Abyss,<br>Louise had become powerful indeed, but had also gone fully insane. She now<br>wanders the halls of the dungeon, seeking other adventurers to share her fate. | <br>一个强大的女术师，用重甲全副武装。<br>她曾经是一个寻找传说中的佐特宝珠的冒险者，但途中被打入深渊，并彻底迷失在那里。<br>她被某个更强大的存在玩弄着，被困在那个充满敌意的位面中近十年之久。<br>在最终逃离深渊的时候，路易丝变得极为强大，但也完全失去了理智。<br>现在她徘徊在地牢之中，想让其他冒险者也承受与她一样的命运。 | adjust | 重甲女术原冒险求Orb遭Abyss迷失玩弄、困近十年后强疯再传祸齐全，但nearly decade被强化长达十年且迷失细节弱化。 MON-093 已修复：恢复近十年，不强化为足十年；可补明确迷失Abyss经历。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:lurking horror | <br>A formless mass of negative energy, bound to bring terrible torment once the<br>forces holding it together dissolve. The alien presence of intruders to the<br>Abyss is sure to unravel it, yet it seems perversely drawn toward them; still,<br>it seems somehow reluctant to move while being observed. | <br>一个无定形的负能量团，一旦维系它的力量消失，势必带来可怕的折磨。<br>闯入者对深渊而言格格不入的存在必定会令它瓦解，它却反常地被他们吸引。<br>不过，在被观察的时候，它似乎不太想移动。 | keep | 负能团维系散即torment、Abyss侵者激散却吸引、被看不动齐全；此条观察停动正确，不可套creeping inferno旧误译。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:maggie | <br>In a distant time, Maggie was apprenticed to the dreaded Hell Knights - but she<br>grew impatient. In search of a shortcut to fame and fortune (and somewhat short<br>on imagination), she entered the Dungeon and set out to slay a dragon. Now<br>having slain one, Maggie sees no reason to stop. | <br>在遥远的岁月里，玛吉是可怕的地狱骑士的学徒——但她变得不耐烦了。<br>为了寻找成名和发财的捷径（有点缺乏想象力），<br>她进入了地牢，并着手杀死了一条龙。<br>现在已经杀了一个，玛吉觉得没有理由停下来。 | keep | 旧HellKnight学徒不耐烦求捷径杀龙、已杀一龙仍继续齐全；着手杀死了略拗非语义错。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:mana viper | <br>A violet-scaled serpent with faintly glowing eyes. It thirsts for magic as well<br>as flesh, and its bite can drink dry the magical reservoirs of even a powerful<br>mage in no time. | <br>一条长有紫色鳞片和微微发光的眼睛的巨蛇。它对魔法的渴望如同对肉的渴望一样，<br>它的咬击能在短时间内吸干哪怕强大法师的魔力储备。 | adjust | 紫鳞微亮眼魔蛇渴魔肉、咬可很快吸干强法库被译一口必清空，情态/次数强化。 MON-094 已修复：保留可迅速吸干的能力，不保证一口必清空强法全部魔力；核AF_ANTIMAGIC实际量。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:mara | <br>This tall and powerful demon is Mara, Lord of Illusions, mighty among dreamers.<br>He is capable of creating intricately detailed illusions, so real that they are<br>almost as deadly as the creatures they impersonate. | <br>这个高大而强大的恶魔名叫玛拉，是幻象领主、梦者中的强者。<br>他能制造结构精巧的幻象，真实得几乎与所模仿的生物同样致命。 | keep | 高强幻主梦者、精细幻象近与原物同致命齐全，几乎未改等同真生物。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:margery | <br>A lithe spellcaster in service to the powers of Hell; it is her duty to ensure<br>that the inhabitants of the Dungeon never forget their place. She personally<br>slew the ancient dragon from whose hide her strange armour is crafted. | <br>一个服侍于地狱力量的灵巧的施法者；<br>她的职责是确保地牢居民永远不会忘记自己的地位。<br>她亲手杀死了一条古老的龙，她那奇怪的盔甲是用它的皮制作的。 | keep | 灵巧Hell法师令Dungeon民知位、手屠古龙其皮作怪甲齐全，所有权关系清楚。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:marrowcuda | <br>The flame-wreathed skeleton of a carnivorous fish, darting through air as easily<br>as it once parted water. It burns with a hunger it could not satisfy in life and<br>is singularly driven by in death.<br><br>While a single one may be only a nuisance, the swarm is never far behind, and<br>every bite it lands will summon more and more of them until every scrap of flesh<br>on its prey has been devoured. | <br>一具被火焰缠绕的肉食鱼骷髅，如曾经分开水流般轻松地在空中穿梭。<br>它燃烧着生前无法满足、死后单一驱动的饥饿。<br><br>虽然单独一只可能只是个小麻烦，但鱼群永远不会落后太远，<br>它每咬一口都会召唤越来越多的同伙，直到猎物身上的每一丝肉都被吞噬殆尽。 | keep | 火裹肉食鱼骨空飞、生前饥未足死后驱动、每咬召更多群吞尽齐全；拗口单一驱动仅语言润色。 MON-102 Suggestion保留：火裹肉食鱼骨空飞、生前饥未足死后驱动、每咬召更多群吞尽齐全；拗口单一驱动仅语言润色。 可接受表达的明确化/自然度建议，非必改。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:maurice | <br>A sly, conniving thief. A self-proclaimed legend, he was one of the most skilled<br>and crafty of the thieves and rogues lured by the Orb. | monster-body:meat hydra | <br>One of the legions of abominations created by the sculptors of flesh. Each of<br>its eight necks is distended and elongated, connected to a colossal body<br>crumpled and dripping with ichor. Its many heads spew blood while writhing and<br>convulsing in agony, as it brings torment to itself and anything else that<br>beholds its foul visage. | <br>由肉雕师制造的憎恶军团中的一员。<br>它的八个脖子都被伸展拉长，与一个起皱的、滴着腐液的巨大身体相连。<br>它的许多头痛苦地翻滚、痉挛着，并吐出鲜血，<br>它给它自己和任何见到它那污秽容貌的人带来了痛苦。 | keep | 肉雕hydra八长颈、皱大躯滴ichor、血头痛抽torment自己与目击者齐全；腐液与普通痛苦的具体语境等地图书核，不先套Nemelex或技能名。 生产入口："dat/des/sprint/meat.des:28-31; spells:symbol_of_torment.80.natural" 生命周期：current explicit dbname | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monsters.txt:4039；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monsters.txt:3025；{"boundary": "Per-identity EN/ZH propositions read above; YAMLcore facts and selected book/producer evidence below. | monster-body:menkaure | <br>A fair and noble ruler of an ancient and mighty kingdom, mummified after an<br>early death. His faithful priests subsequently infused him with great and<br>powerful magic, seeking to grant him eternal life. Now he is forgotten and<br>reduced to mouldering bandages and dry, brittle bones. | <br>他是强盛的古国中的一位公正而崇高的统治者，英年早逝后被做成了木乃伊。<br>他忠实的祭司们随后为他注入了强大的魔法，试图让他永生。<br>现在他已经被遗忘了，只剩腐烂的布条和干燥、脆弱的骸骨。 | keep | 公正古国王英逝木乃伊、祭司强魔求永生、今被忘腐布脆骨齐全。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:mennas | <br>There was once a human priest named Mennas. He travelled far and wide as a<br>missionary of Zin, often venturing even into Orcish lands. He beseeched the orcs<br>to abandon their false tribes and return to the peoples of their birth; only<br>Zin's light could truly cleanse the weight of sin that had twisted their bodies.<br><br>By all accounts the orcs were not happy with Mennas. Eventually, a group of them<br>demanded he recant his words and when Mennas remained silent, they cut out his<br>tongue.<br><br>Whether or not this angel is that same Mennas is something of a mystery, as he<br>seems to have difficulty speaking. | <br>曾经有位名叫门纳斯的人类祭司。他作为辛的传教士四处远行，甚至经常深入兽人领地。<br>他恳求兽人抛弃虚假的部族，回归自己出生的族群；唯有辛之光才能真正洗净<br>令其身体扭曲的沉重罪孽。<br><br>无论何种记载，兽人都显然对此不满。最后，一群兽人要求他收回这些话；<br>门纳斯始终沉默，于是它们割掉了他的舌头。<br><br>这个天使是否就是那位门纳斯仍是谜团，因为他似乎难以开口说话。 | keep | 人类Zin传教劝Orcs归出生族洗扭体罪、被逼收言不语遭割舌、同名天使身份谜因不善语三段齐全。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. Help usesEnglish enum key and filter; no assertion of random spawnfrequency." 名称/标题关联：[{"en": "Mennas", "identity": "monster:MONS_MENNAS", "unique_title": "门纳斯，辛的代言人\n", "zh": "门纳斯"}] 生命周期：current definition; ordinary/help/internal according to snapshot flags | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monsters.txt:394；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monsters.txt:342；{"boundary": "Per-identity EN/ZH propositions read above; YAMLcore facts and selected book/producer evidence below. | monster-body:mongrel wurm | <br>A serpentine crossbreed, blending traits of lesser dragons and countless other<br>creatures that nature never intended to interbreed. | monster-body:morphogenic ooze | <br>A multihued mire of roiling flesh and fluctuating sludge, striving and failing<br>for more coherence than any other slime. As a fresh carrier of the ruinous<br>contagion that overtook the Slime Pits, it can impart unto others the same<br>horrible fate. While it may not be a permanent transformation for you, the<br>melding of weapons and armour, as well as the severe weakening of spells, may<br>make it a lethal one regardless. | <br>一团多色的翻涌血肉和波动污泥，比其他任何软泥都更努力地争取着<br>连贯性——但始终失败。作为吞没软泥坑的毁灭性传染的新载体，<br>它可以向他人传递同样可怕的命运。虽然对你来说可能不是永久性的变形，<br>但武器和护甲的融合，以及法术的严重削弱，仍可能使其致命。 | keep | 多色肉泥求稳定形失败、Slime灾传新载体、变形玩家不永久但装备meld弱法可致命齐全；连贯性与融合语感可具体化非硬错。 MON-105 Suggestion保留：多色肉泥求稳定形失败、Slime灾传新载体、变形玩家不永久但装备meld弱法可致命齐全；连贯性与融合语感可具体化非硬错。 可接受表达的明确化/自然度建议，非必改。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. For some inexplicable reason, it was eradicated from<br>the surface centuries ago. | <br>一种飞蛾，以其通过触碰它的敌人或仅仅凝视它的友方就能激发狂暴的能力而闻名。<br>由于某些莫名其妙的原因，几个世纪前它就从地表消失了。 | keep | 触敌/望友诱怒、几世纪前被地表灭绝莫名原因齐全；消失弱化eradicated可明确人为除灭，非强判机制错。 MON-106 Suggestion保留：触敌/望友诱怒、几世纪前被地表灭绝莫名原因齐全；消失弱化eradicated可明确人为除灭，非强判机制错。 可接受表达的明确化/自然度建议，非必改。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:mountainshell | <br>An enormous land tortoise whose shell is so thick and rock-encrusted that<br>sleeping ones are frequently mistaken for geological formations. And like a<br>mountain, its exterior is nearly impervious to any destructive force; only at<br>close range can one properly aim for the narrow gaps between its plates to<br>strike the tender flesh within. | <br>一只巨大的陆龟，其龟壳如此厚实且覆盖岩石，以至于睡着的个体常被<br>误认为是地质构造。像山一样，其外表几乎不受任何毁灭力量的影响；<br>只有在近距离才能正确瞄准甲板之间狭窄的缝隙，攻击内部的柔软血肉。 | keep | 巨厚岩龟睡若山、近不毁壳只近瞄板缝软肉齐全，近range非必须近战伤。 MON-107 Suggestion保留：巨厚岩龟睡若山、近不毁壳只近瞄板缝软肉齐全，近range非必须近战伤。 可接受表达的明确化/自然度建议，非必改。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:nameless horror | <br>A malign force from the space between planes. It is hostile to the magic forces<br>that removed it from its home. These horrors are often the result of mistaken<br>summoning spells and have slain many aspiring wizards. | <br>一个来自位面之间的邪恶力量。它对把它带离家园的魔法力量充满敌意。<br>这个恐怖通常是召唤魔法出错的结果，并杀死了许多有抱负的巫师。 | keep | 位面间恶力恨移其出家魔力、常错召生并杀许多见习者齐全，常保留often不概化所有召唤失败。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:nargun | <br>An ancient stone creature that has lived among these frozen caves since before<br>Antaeus rent Cocytus into being. It tolerates its new neighbors begrudgingly,<br>preferring the company of its petrified enemies. Veins of ice permeate its<br>frozen stone flesh. | <br>一个古老的石质生物，早在安泰俄斯撕裂出悲叹河之前便生活在这些冰冻洞穴中。<br>它勉强容忍新邻居，却更喜欢与自己石化的敌人为伍。<br>冰脉在它那冰冻的石肉中流通着。 | keep | Antaeus创Cocytus前冰穴石古生、厌新邻好石化敌、冰脉齐全，Hall命名D-C103当前同根，完整句重新读过。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:natasha | <br>A fast-moving magical cat. Once a powerful wizard's familiar, Natasha was<br>abandoned after her master was consumed by the very necromantic forces he sought<br>to control. Now she patrols the dungeon, taking a bloody vengeance with spell<br>and claw upon any adventurer who crosses her path.<br><br>This cat doesn't have nine lives, but just one death isn't going to be enough<br>to put her down for good. | <br>一只移动迅速、有魔力的猫。娜塔莎曾是一个强大的巫师的伙伴，<br>但在她的主人被他试图控制的死灵力量吞噬后，她被遗弃了。<br>现在她在地牢里巡游，用法术和利爪对任何经过她的路线的冒险者进行血腥的报复。<br><br>这只猫没有九条命，但仅仅一死也不足以让她安息。 | keep | 魔快猫原强巫familiar主被死灵吞留猫、复仇途人、非九命但死一次不足永久除齐全；伙伴可更明确魔宠不误改生命次数。 MON-109 Suggestion保留：魔快猫原强巫familiar主被死灵吞留猫、复仇途人、非九命但死一次不足永久除齐全；伙伴可更明确魔宠不误改生命次数。 可接受表达的明确化/自然度建议，非必改。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. Help usesEnglish enum key and filter; no assertion of random spawnfrequency." 名称/标题关联：[{"en": "Natasha", "identity": "monster:MONS_NATASHA", "unique_title": "娜塔莎，生死仆从\n", "zh": "娜塔莎"}] 生命周期：current definition; ordinary/help/internal according to snapshot flags | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monsters.txt:422；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monsters.txt:367；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monsters.txt:421；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monsters.txt:366；{"boundary": "Per-identity EN/ZH propositions read above; YAMLcore facts and selected book/producer evidence below. | monster-body:necrophage | <br>A vile undead creation of the most unholy necromancy, made from the decaying<br>corpses of humanoid creatures. It exists to spread disease and decay. | <br>一个被最邪恶的死灵法术创造出来的亡灵造物，其身体由人形生物的腐尸拼凑而成。<br>它的存在的就是为了散布疾病与腐化。 | keep | 不圣死魔由烂人形尸造尸病腐坏齐全；存在的就是冗字与腐化现代歧义可作建议，不只词表断wrong。 MON-110 Suggestion保留：不圣死魔由烂人形尸造尸病腐坏齐全；存在的就是冗字与腐化现代歧义可作建议，不只词表断wrong。 可接受表达的明确化/自然度建议，非必改。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:nekomata | <br>An upright feliform trickster of an elderly demon, with a forked tail ablaze<br>with a shimmering haze. It holds a deep disdain for mortal humanoids, a<br>patronising pity for mortal cats, and enough mystic might to subjugate both. | <br>一只直立的猫形老年恶魔骗子，叉尾燃烧着闪烁的薄雾。<br>它对凡人两足生物怀有深深的蔑视，对凡人猫抱有傲慢的怜悯，<br>并拥有足够的魔法力量来征服两者。 | keep | 直立老恶猫叉尾朦火、轻蔑凡人偏爱怜猫与魔支配两者齐全；骗子口吻可更神话狡黠，不强按具体原典神名。 MON-111 Suggestion保留：直立老恶猫叉尾朦火、轻蔑凡人偏爱怜猫与魔支配两者齐全；骗子口吻可更神话狡黠，不强按具体原典神名。 可接受表达的明确化/自然度建议，非必改。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:nergalle | <br>A shrewd and wizened orc who has devoted her life to chronicling the bloody<br>history of her people. She claims to know the names and deeds of every last orc<br>who lost their life in their great exodus into the Dungeon, and even if this is<br>a lie, she nonetheless seems to be on a first-name basis with many of them.<br><br>More than any other orc still breathing, she knows the blood and sacrifice it<br>took to make this place a refuge for her kind. She will not brook its being<br>intruded upon by anyone - least of all you. | <br>一位精明而衰老的兽人，毕生致力于记录族人的血腥历史。<br>她声称知道每一个在兽人大举迁入地牢时丧命者的姓名与事迹；<br>即便这是谎言，她似乎仍与其中许多人熟识到能直呼其名。<br><br>她比任何仍在呼吸的兽人都更清楚，为使此地成为族人的避难所曾付出多少鲜血与牺牲。<br>她绝不容许任何人闯入——尤其是你。 | keep | 精明衰老史官、迁徙死者姓名功业/熟识、族群避难血祭和拒侵三段完整，未把传闻断言为真。 MON-199 Suggestion保留：Lorekeeper of the Fallen与编写族史可自然为亡者史官/亡者史传守护者，现亡者的传说守护者可理解，属清晰度建议。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. Help usesEnglish enum key and filter; no assertion of random spawnfrequency." 名称/标题关联：[{"en": "Nergalle", "identity": "monster:MONS_NERGALLE", "unique_title": "内尔加勒，亡者的传说守护者\n", "zh": "内尔加勒"}] 生命周期：current definition; ordinary/help/internal according to snapshot flags | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monsters.txt:438；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monsters.txt:380；crawl-ref/source/dat/database/montitle.txt；crawl-ref/source/dat/database/zh/montitle.txt；crawl-ref/source/dat/mons/nergalle.yaml；{"boundary": "Per-identity EN/ZH propositions read above; YAMLcore facts and selected book/producer evidence below. | monster-body:nobody | <br>A time-lost revenant, risen not from the death of a single individual but of<br>many - its bones fused together from the young and the elderly and different<br>species altogether. Whether they were all the victims of a single massacre or<br>a thousand souls discarded over a thousand years is impossible to say now;<br>history does not remember them.<br><br>But one thing is clear: they will fight to change that until every last memory<br>they have left burns away. | <br>一个迷失于时光中的归来者，不是从一个人的死亡中升起，而是从许多人——<br>其骨骼融合了年轻人和老人以及完全不同的物种。他们究竟是单场大屠杀的受害者，<br>还是千年间被遗弃的一千个灵魂，如今已无法判断；历史不记得他们。<br><br>但有一件事是明确的：他们将为此而战，直到他们留下的每一份记忆燃烧殆尽。 | keep | 集体归来者来源、融合多族年龄、屠杀或千年弃魂、历史遗忘与残存记忆消耗均保留；“不是…而是从许多人——”句式略悬，可写“由许多死者一同化成”；非机制必改。 MON-112 Suggestion保留：集体归来者来源、融合多族年龄、屠杀或千年弃魂、历史遗忘与残存记忆消耗均保留；“不是…而是从许多人——”句式略悬，可写“由许多死者一同化成”；非机制必改。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. Help usesEnglish enum key and filter; no assertion of random spawnfrequency." 名称/标题关联：[{"en": "Nobody", "identity": "monster:MONS_NAMELESS_REVENANT", "unique_title": "无名氏，未被哀悼者的怨恨\n", "zh": "无名氏"}] 生命周期：current definition; ordinary/help/internal according to snapshot flags | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monsters.txt:460；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monsters.txt:3134；{"boundary": "Per-identity EN/ZH propositions read above; YAMLcore facts and selected book/producer evidence below. | monster-body:oblivion hound | <br>A demon lapdog of the queen of Tartarus, bound to hunt her enemies. The first<br>time a foe hears its howl, it will echo in their mind, calling nightmarish<br>creatures to hunt them. Those who survive have the small consolation of being<br>inoculated against that particular hound's howl. | <br>塔尔塔罗斯女王的恶魔宠犬，受命猎杀她的敌人。<br>当敌人第一次听到它的嚎叫时，嚎叫会在他们的脑海中回响，<br>呼唤噩梦般的生物来猎杀他们。<br>幸存者尚能得到一点安慰：从此不再受这只猎犬嚎叫的影响。 | keep | 单一foe的they可用无代词“嚎声在其脑海回响，召来噩梦生物追猎”；现译敌人可泛称，未误改一次性/特定猎犬免疫条件。 MON-113 Suggestion保留：单一foe的they可用无代词“嚎声在其脑海回响，召来噩梦生物追猎”；现译敌人可泛称，未误改一次性/特定猎犬免疫条件。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:observer | <br>You see the unseen, you stare and they stare back. They whisper and laugh, they<br>grin and cry, they leer at you with contempt and gaze at you in adoration. They<br>are the observers, they are the judge of your worth and will decide your end. | <br>你看着看不见的，你凝视着他们，他们也凝视着你。<br>他们低语着，笑着，他们又笑又哭，他们轻蔑地睨视着你，崇敬地凝望着你。<br>他们是观察者，他们是你的价值的仲裁，并决定着你的结局。 | defer implementation | 观察者不可见对视、低语笑哭、蔑视崇敬、判价值定结局齐全；“价值的仲裁”可写“评判你价值的裁判”，保持恐怖反复修辞。 生产入口：{"judgment": "Matchingname:/n_adj/n_rpl affects display only; withoutdbname: it does not select thisTextDBbody. | monster-body:obsidian statue | <br>A beautiful statue of an unknown creature, jet-black like a tear in reality.<br>Its eyes glow with an otherworldly, malignant radiance. | <br>一尊美丽的未知生物的雕像，通体漆黑，宛如现实被撕开的一道裂口。<br>它的眼睛闪烁着超乎寻常的邪恶光芒。 | adjust | tear在jet-black like a tear in reality中是现实裂隙，非泪珠；jet-black是漆黑非晶莹黑玉。改“通体漆黑，宛如现实被撕开的一道裂口”。 MON-114 已修复：tear在jet-black like a tear in reality中是现实裂隙，非泪珠；jet-black是漆黑非晶莹黑玉。改“通体漆黑，宛如现实被撕开的一道裂口”。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:oni incarcerator | <br>An infamous, dutiful retainer of Gehenna. These immense and indomitable oni<br>weave their weapons through reality itself to reach and capture the innumerable<br>damned souls owed to the hells upon their deaths. | <br>欣嫩谷的一个臭名昭著、忠诚的侍从。这些巨大而不可征服的鬼<br>让武器穿透现实本身，触及并捕获无数在死后归地狱所有的受诅灵魂。 | keep | 欣嫩谷忠诚臭名侍从、武器穿现实捕死后应归地狱亡魂完整。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:ophan | <br>A creature from the heavenly realms. It consists of a wheel within a wheel, and<br>both of these are covered in eyes; strange flames of holy fire flicker all over<br>it. To be seen by its countless eyes is to be highlighted and branded as both<br>dissident and quarry for its allies to hunt down. | <br>一个来自天国的生物。<br>它由轮中套轮构成，两个轮上都布满眼睛，周身闪烁着奇异圣火。<br>被它无数只眼睛看见，就会被标记为异端与猎物，供它的盟友追猎。 | keep | 天界轮套轮、双轮眼圣火、被看见显标异端猎物供盟追猎齐全；实际标记另核。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:orange crystal statue | <br>An intricately carved idol of some nameless godling, hewn of translucent orange<br>crystal. Its lifeless eyes seem to glitter uncannily with a wicked<br>intelligence. It is capable of unleashing a powerful psychic assault upon the<br>minds of any who approach it. | <br>某个无名小神的神像，用半透明的橙色水晶细致地雕刻而成。<br>它那无生命的眼睛似乎闪烁着邪恶的智慧。<br>它会对任何接近它的人的心灵发动强大的精神攻击。 | adjust | “神祗”为错字，应“神祇”；godling可作小神/次神，半透明translucent现“透明”建议改“半透明”。保留无名神像、邪智眼、靠近精神攻击。 MON-116 已修复：“神祗”为错字，应“神祇”；godling可作小神/次神，半透明translucent现“透明”建议改“半透明”。保留无名神像、邪智眼、靠近精神攻击。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. Help usesEnglish enum key and filter; no assertion of random spawnfrequency." 名称/标题关联：[{"en": "orange crystal statue", "identity": "monster:MONS_ORANGE_STATUE", "unique_title": null, "zh": "橙色水晶雕像"}] 生命周期：current definition; ordinary/help/internal according to snapshot flags | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monsters.txt:2385；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monsters.txt:1816；{"boundary": "Per-identity EN/ZH propositions read above; YAMLcore facts and selected book/producer evidence below. | monster-body:orb guardian | <br>A huge, glowing, four-limbed purple creature with heightened senses, created by<br>the Orb itself. It guards the Orb with enormous punctiliousness and violence,<br>and its death will alert any Boundless Tesseracts on the level to begin creating<br>reinforcements.<br><br>Unless the Orb has already been disturbed, it will refuse to abandon its duty<br>by leaving the floor. | <br>一个巨大、发光的紫色四肢生物，有着特别敏锐的知觉，被宝珠自身所创造。<br>它一丝不苟而又凶暴地守护着宝珠；它一旦死亡，就会惊动本层所有<br>无界超立方体，使其开始制造援军。<br><br>除非宝珠已经受到惊扰，否则它绝不会离开本层、擅离职守。 | keep | 宝珠创守卫紫色四肢敏感、死惊本层tesseracts造援、未惊宝珠不离层齐全。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:pillar of rime | <br>A spire of strangely tenebrous ice, its brittle tendrils reaching skyward like<br>the fingers of an outstretched hand. {{<br>    if spells.memorised("rimeblight") then<br>        return "If only the dying breath of every soul could create such art."<br>    else<br>        return "It might even be beautiful if you didn't know the gruesome " ..<br>               "way it formed."<br>    end<br>}} | <br>一根奇异阴暗寒冰的尖塔，其脆弱的卷须像伸出的手指一样伸向天空。{{<br>    if spells.memorised("rimeblight") then<br>        return "如果每个灵魂的临终之息都能创造这样的艺术该多好。"<br>    else<br>        return "如果你不知道它形成的可怕方式，它甚至可能是美丽的。"<br>    end<br>}} | keep | 阴冰塔脆卷须手指喻、是否记Rimeblight两Lua返回完整且同条件，艺术赞叹/不知残酷形成均齐。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:polterguardian | <br>Many poltergeists are fiercely territorial over the domains they choose to<br>haunt, but these have extended that protection even to the people who share<br>their domain with them. Some say they must be the lingering souls of those who<br>guarded the Vaults in life; others suggest the Ironbound Order simply recruited<br>them in common cause. Whichever is true, their very presence shelters other<br>creatures from missiles, causing sling and spell alike to veer off-course at the<br>last moment. | <br>许多骚灵对它们选择附身的领域极其有领地意识，但这些甚至将<br>保护延伸到了与它们共享领域的人们。有人说它们必定是在生前守卫<br>宝库之人的徘徊灵魂；其他人则认为铁缚团只是在共同目标下招募了它们。<br>无论哪种是真实的，它们的存在本身就庇护其他生物免受投射物伤害，<br>使投石索和法术在最后一刻偏转方向。 | keep | 此处haunt领域是出没/盘踞，现“附身的领域”不自然，建议“盘踞的地界”；守Vault或招募两说、存在庇护投射偏移均齐。 MON-131 Suggestion保留：此处haunt领域是出没/盘踞，现“附身的领域”不自然，建议“盘踞的地界”；守Vault或招募两说、存在庇护投射偏移均齐。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:polyphemus | <br>A cyclops shepherd, he is very protective of his charges, whom he watches with<br>an undying fervor through his single massive eye. Nevertheless, he won't<br>hesitate to use them as projectiles in a pinch; after all, the best defence is<br>a good offence. | <br>这个独眼巨人牧羊人，非常爱惜自己的牲畜，<br>他用那只透露着永恒热情的巨大的眼睛注视着它们。<br>尽管如此，在紧要关头，他还是会毫不犹豫地将它们用作弹丸；<br>毕竟，最好的防守就是好的进攻。 | keep | 独眼牧者护牲畜激情监视、危急也可投射牲畜及攻即守幽默齐全。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:scrapshell chimera | <br>A living engine of aquatic animal flesh fused with a colossal mass of bewitched<br>metal scrap. | monster-body:sculptor of flesh | <br>An artisan of unlife, the sculptor appears as a grim skeletal form. It has six<br>long arms ending in mangled hands with broken fingers, upon which it crawls<br>like a spider. Its skull is abnormally large and full of holes. Its bones are<br>reddened and fractured, inscribed with the unholy spells it weaves to assemble<br>its puppets. | <br>这位雕工是亡灵的工匠，外形是阴冷的骨架。<br>它有六支长臂，末端是残缺的手掌和断了的手指，利用这些它像一只蜘蛛一样爬行。<br>它的头骨异常的大而且布满了洞。<br>它的骨头发红并断裂，上面刻有它用来装配傀儡的邪恶咒语。 | defer implementation | 骨工匠六长残臂断指蛛爬、孔颅红裂骨刻造傀术齐全。 生产入口：{"judgment": "Matchingname:/n_adj/n_rpl affects display only; withoutdbname: it does not select thisTextDBbody. | monster-body:sigmund | <br>The elder of a pair of brothers who came for the Orb. No one knows what Sigmund<br>saw in the dungeon to drive him mad, but his shrewd magical tactics and wicked<br>scythe now leave little time for his victims to wonder. Despite his reputation<br>as a vicious murderer, his grandiose and dramatic ways have earned him the<br>admiration of many denizens of the dungeon. | <br>他是为宝珠而来的一对兄弟中的哥哥。<br>没人知道西格蒙德在地牢里看到了什么因而发疯，<br>但他狡猾的魔法战术和厉害的镰刀现在可没有留给让他的受害者好奇的时间。<br>尽管他有恶毒的凶手的名声，但他浮夸而戏剧化的手法赢得了许多地牢居民的赞叹。 | keep | 哥哥寻Orb疯因未知、诡术利镰不给好奇时间、凶名却夸张风受仰齐全；删“留给让”中“让”修小语病。 MON-157 Suggestion保留：哥哥寻Orb疯因未知、诡术利镰不给好奇时间、凶名却夸张风受仰齐全；删“留给让”中“让”修小语病。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:sky beast | <br>A strange aerial creature formed of fleshy clouds and electric feathers. It<br>commands the faint wind currents of the Dungeon with every strike, which will<br>buffet its victims in dramatic correlation to the amount of open air around<br>said prey. | <br>一种奇异的空中生物，由血肉般的云团与带电羽毛构成。<br>它每次攻击都会驱使地牢中微弱的气流；猎物周围越空旷，<br>遭受的狂风冲击就越猛烈。 | keep | 血肉云电羽空生物、每击气流随猎物周围空旷度强弱齐全。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:sleepcap | <br>A surprisingly ambulatory mushroom. It wafts its spores over prey to send them<br>into a deep sleep, making it simple for the fungus to kill and devour them.<br>It can take months for its mycelia to fully infiltrate and digest victims. | <br>一个令人惊奇的会走动的蘑菇。它能将孢子飘散到猎物身上，<br>使猎物进入深度睡眠，这样真菌就能轻易杀死并吞噬它们。<br>菌丝可能需要数月时间才能完全侵入并消化受害者。 | keep | 行菇孢催眠便杀吞、菌丝消化耗数月齐全。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:slymdra | <br>A quivering amalgam of viscous slime, its many pseudopods gnashing at the air<br>like a throng of reptilian maws. It rapidly absorbs nearby slime creatures into<br>itself, growing a new 'head' for each one and becoming even more resilient.<br><br>Whether through convergent evolution or genetic memory, it also shares the<br>hydra's most infamous trait: lopping off a head with a bladed weapon will just<br>make it grow two more unless the wound is cauterised by a flaming weapon.<br><br>When not stalking prey, its constituent slimes may separate from it again,<br>perhaps to seek new food sources on their own. | <br>一团颤动的黏稠软泥，其众多伪足像一群爬行动物的嘴一样在空中咬啮。<br>它迅速将附近的软泥生物吸收进自身，每个都长出一个新"头"并变得<br>更加坚韧。<br><br>无论是通过趋同进化还是遗传记忆，它也分享了多头蛇最臭名昭著的特征：<br>用利器砍掉一个头只会让它再长出两个，除非伤口被火焰武器烧灼。<br><br>当不追踪猎物时，其组成的软泥可能再次与它分离，<br>也许是为了自己寻找新的食物来源。 | keep | 软泥伪头吸附近slimes逐头增韧、利器断一生二除火灼、未追猎可再分离三段齐全。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:snorg | <br>A particularly corpulent troll with a short temper and a sizable gut.<br>Uninterested in the Orb, Snorg delights in the endless parade of adventurers –<br>that is, easy meals — it attracts. | <br>一个特别肥胖的巨魔，脾气暴躁，腹部硕大。斯诺格对宝珠并不感兴趣，<br>她喜爱的是宝珠源源不断引来的冒险者——也就是送上门的美餐。 | adjust | it attracts指宝珠吸引源源冒险者作轻易一餐，中文句断为“冒险者的…行进…吸引了他”，漏Orb引客并语法混乱。改“斯诺格不关心宝珠，只喜爱它源源引来的冒险者——也就是送上门的饭”。 MON-158 已修复：it attracts指宝珠吸引源源冒险者作轻易一餐，中文句断为“冒险者的…行进…吸引了他”，漏Orb引客并语法混乱。改“斯诺格不关心宝珠，只喜爱它源源引来的冒险者——也就是送上门的饭”。 MON-193 已修复：当前明确女性，正文两他应她。与本条Orb吸引饭客句法修复同次完成，勿只修顺句而遗留性别。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:solar ember | <br>A mote of intense light and heat manifested by a sun scarab. It is linked to<br>their essence and will never leave their side, being reconstituted time and time<br>again whenever it is extinguished.<br><br>Some myths even claim that the sun which shines down upon the outside world was<br>once carried around by such a scarab. | <br>由太阳圣甲虫显现的一粒强烈光与热。它与这只圣甲虫的本质相连，<br>永远不会离开这只圣甲虫身边，每当被熄灭时都被一次又一次地重新构造。<br><br>有些神话甚至声称照耀外部世界的太阳曾经由这样一只圣甲虫携带。 | keep | scarab光热微粒、依本质不离伴反复再造、外界太阳曾由甲虫带的神话保推测齐全。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:starcursed mass | <br>A mass of stellar detritus that glows with the sickly putrescence of a dying<br>star, forever shrieking soundlessly in a voice beyond mortal grasp. Its form<br>undulates constantly, dividing spontaneously and then withdrawing when<br>threatened. When divided, its deafening chorus of screams can overwhelm the<br>minds of even the bravest warriors, leaving them stunned and helpless. | <br>一团星星的碎片，散发着垂死星星的病态腐化的光芒，永远无声地尖叫着，<br>发出凡人无法理解的声音。其形态常常在波动，自发地分裂，受到威胁时又缩回去。<br>当分裂时，它那震耳欲聋的齐声尖叫能压垮哪怕最勇敢的战士的理智，<br>使他们陷入眩晕、无力反抗。 | keep | 星屑垂死病腐光、凡人难懂无声尖叫、分裂遇威胁撤回及分后合唱震慑齐全。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:telencephalon | <br>An abandoned arcane experiment, its original purpose more inscrutable than most.<br>Made of magical crystal fused with mutant brain tissue, it bobs about<br>autonomously and erratically, sparking all the while.<br><br>When badly damaged, it will unleash a staggering telekinetic shockwave, knocking<br>back those in its surroundings and inflicting irresistible confusion on any who<br>might harm it. | <br>一个被遗弃的奥术实验，其原本的用途比大多数实验更令人费解。<br>它由魔法晶体与变异脑组织融合而成，自行忽上忽下地飘动，毫无规律，<br>还不断迸出火花。<br><br>严重受损时，它会释放出强大的念力冲击波，击退周围的生物，<br>并使任何可能伤害它的生物陷入无法抵抗的混乱。 | keep | 弃奥实验用途不解、晶脑融合自主乱浮火花、重伤念波击退周围并不可抗惑敌完整。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:test spawner | <br>(If you see this outside wizmode or the arena, this is a bug.)<br><br>Whatever it is, it is capable of spawning countless monsters by casting Shadow<br>Creatures, and is virtually undestructible itself.<br><br>To destroy it, lower the central elevator pillar, then pump rockets into the<br>hole in its exposed brain when the pillar rises to an appropriate height. You<br>can add another rocket while jumping down.<br><br>Oh wait, wrong game. | <br>（如果你在向导或竞技场模式之外见到它，说明你遇到程序错误了。）<br><br>不管它是什么，反正它能靠施放阴影生物法术来产生无数的怪物，<br>而且它本身基本不可能被破坏。<br><br>要想破坏它，你得把中间的升降柱降下去，<br>然后赶在柱子回升到原本的高度前用火箭轰击它暴露在外的脑洞。<br>你可以在跳下时候再加一个火箭。<br><br>噢，等等，好像串戏了。 | keep | 测试怪Shadow Creatures无尽生怪、极难毁、Doom升降台火箭笑话齐全；appropriate height现原高度前不完全精确，建议“升到合适高度时”，保原梗。 MON-171 Suggestion保留：测试怪Shadow Creatures无尽生怪、极难毁、Doom升降台火箭笑话齐全；appropriate height现原高度前不完全精确，建议“升到合适高度时”，保原梗。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:the meatlord | <br>You behold the embodiment of filth, corruption and depravity: the Meatlord. His<br>foul body is bloated to the extreme, leaking viscous fluid and the stench of<br>death. His head is that of a boar with bulging eyes and tusks split in two, his<br>snout flares and oozes as he snorts and squeals at the sight of you, and his<br>mouth is a toothless rift which drools pools of blood and vomits forth<br>disgusting remains. His neck is stretched and lops forward, its skin sagging<br>downward. His immense gut writhes and distorts as the larvae within await their<br>repugnant release. His legs are unrecognisable masses of flesh, covered in<br>protrusions and throbbing boils. Your mind reels at the sight of this hideous<br>form, and your senses begin to shut down in an attempt to preserve your sanity<br>as you choke on the oppressive stench. | <br>你看到了污秽、腐化和堕落的化身：血肉领主。<br>他那肮脏的身体膨胀到了极致，渗着稠液，散发出死亡的恶臭。<br>他的头如同野猪，双眼凸出，獠牙裂成两半；一见到你，他便喷着鼻息、尖声嚎叫，<br>鼻孔张大，淌出液体。他的嘴是个没有牙的裂口，血水从中流淌成池，<br>还吐出令人作呕的残渣。他的脖子伸长、向前耷拉，皮肤松松地下垂。<br>他那巨大的腹部不停蠕动、扭曲，里面的幼虫正等待着令人作呕地涌出。<br>他的双腿已是难以辨认的团团血肉，上面满是突起和跳动的脓包。<br>目睹这副丑恶形体，你的心神为之动摇；浓烈恶臭令你窒息，<br>你的感官也开始关闭，试图借此保住理智。 | defer implementation | 脖子耷拉句重复两次确定赘抄；tusks split in two非仅两个獠牙、immense gut是巨腹非肠道。删重复并补“裂开的獠牙/巨腹蠕动”，保完整厌恶描写和理智闭感结尾。 MON-172 已修复：脖子耷拉句重复两次确定赘抄；tusks split in two非仅两个獠牙、immense gut是巨腹非肠道。删重复并补“裂开的獠牙/巨腹蠕动”，保完整厌恶描写和理智闭感结尾。 生产入口：{"judgment": "Matchingname:/n_adj/n_rpl affects display only; withoutdbname: it does not select thisTextDBbody. No matchingdefinition/derived/explicitdbname route found in the finite current source closure. | monster-body:undertaker | <br>The Dungeon's vast repositories of the dead and the unholy realms thereafter<br>both require regular restocking and reorganisation, far beyond the coordination<br>of the restless dead. | monster-body:urug | <br>A coarse and lanky orc. Urug lost her eye in a fight with a harpy, and has<br>sworn to slay every last one of them. Unfortunately, the vision in her<br>remaining eye is not very good, and she has mistaken you for one.<br>{{<br>    if you.can_smell() then<br>        return "She smells terrible."<br>    end<br>}} | <br>一个身形粗犷、瘦长的兽人。<br>乌鲁格在与鸟妖的战斗中失去了一只眼睛，因此发誓要把世上的鸟妖全部杀光。<br>不幸的是，由于她剩下的一只眼视力不太好，她把你当成了鸟妖。<br>{{<br>    if you.can_smell() then<br>        return "她很难闻。"<br>    end<br>}} | keep | Urug失眼于harpy仇尽杀、余眼弱误认玩家、can_smell才恶臭Lua两侧同完整。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:vv | <br>One of the Stoneborn, formed untold aeons ago with supreme command over rock.<br>Her people shelter deep within the living earth, so whatever has forced Vv<br>into the oppressive openness of the Dungeon must be dire indeed. But whatever<br>it is, she's not talking... | <br>不知多少纪元前诞生的石裔之一，拥有对岩石的至高的控制力。<br>她的人民躲避在充满活力的大地深处，<br>因此迫使芙芙进入压抑、空旷的地牢的东西一定是很可怕的。<br>但不管是什么，她都不说话…… | adjust | untold aeons是无法计量的悠远年代，现“数万年前”给出无据且大幅缩小的确定年代。改“不知多少纪元前诞生”；石裔控岩、深土族遭迫空旷地牢不说缘由齐全。 MON-181 已修复：untold aeons是无法计量的悠远年代，现“数万年前”给出无据且大幅缩小的确定年代。改“不知多少纪元前诞生”；石裔控岩、深土族遭迫空旷地牢不说缘由齐全。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:walking crystal tome | <br>A spellbook that has gone too long without being read. | monster-body:wandering mushroom | <br>A large, fleshy mushroom that wanders slowly around the dungeon. It is both<br>innately curious and incredibly shy, pursuing the objects of its curiosity only<br>when out of sight. Noxious spores drift around its cap. | <br>一个在地牢中慢慢游走的大型肉质蘑菇。它有与生俱来的好奇心，而且又非常害羞，<br>只有在没有人看着的时候才会去追寻引起它好奇心的东西。<br>它的菌帽旁有毒性孢子在飘动。 | keep | 大肉菇慢游好奇羞、无人看才追、毒孢帽齐全。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:wyrmhole | <br>A small and strangely serpentine fold in space and time. Scholars once<br>theorised the Dungeon's easy access to manifold unholy realms is due to the<br>tunneling of yet-undiscovered translocations dragons. Whether or not this is<br>true, distant stars mottle this drake's endless lengths, and dimensions bend to<br>its writhing whim. | <br>一个在空间和时间中小而奇特蛇形的折叠。学者们曾推测地牢对多样的<br>不神圣领域的轻易通达是由于尚未被发现的传送龙类的挖掘。<br>无论这是否真实，遥远的星辰点缀着这条龙兽无尽的长度，而维度则<br>屈从于它扭动的怪念。 | keep | 小蛇时空折、学者移位龙掘通多邪域推测、星点无限长体维度随身齐全；中文直译可自然化，不以“虫洞”少龙字自动判错。 MON-189 Suggestion保留：小蛇时空折、学者移位龙掘通多邪域推测、星点无限长体维度随身齐全；中文直译可自然化，不以“虫洞”少龙字自动判错。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:xak'krixis | <br>It has been centuries since outsiders were last allowed access to the cavernous<br>libraries of the formicids, but their emissaries are still seen from time to<br>time - surveying other lands for resources or scientific discoveries that might<br>aid the colony.<br><br>This one's study of the magical fibres excreted by orb spiders has already led<br>to an alchemical breakthrough, allowing them to shape fulminant prisms such that<br>their explosions are directed at enemies alone. Alas, their enthusiasm to<br>conduct a field test bodes poorly for your health. | <br>距离外人上次获准进入蚁族洞窟般宏大的图书馆，已经过去了几个世纪。<br>但他们的使者仍时常出现，巡视其他土地，寻找可能有益于族群的资源或科学发现。<br><br>这位使者对魔球蛛分泌的魔法纤维的研究，已经促成了一项炼金术突破，<br>使其造出的爆炸棱镜在爆炸时只攻击敌人。唉，这位使者热衷于实地试验，<br>对你的健康可不是好兆头。 | adjust | orb spiders现“圆蛛”与本体魔球蛛错指/失联；改“魔球蛛分泌的魔法纤维”。formicid封库数世纪使者寻资源科学、研究促棱镜仅爆敌与现场试验威胁三段均需保持。 MON-190 已修复：orb spiders现“圆蛛”与本体魔球蛛错指/失联；改“魔球蛛分泌的魔法纤维”。formicid封库数世纪使者寻资源科学、研究促棱镜仅爆敌与现场试验威胁三段均需保持。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. Help usesEnglish enum key and filter; no assertion of random spawnfrequency." 名称/标题关联：[{"en": "Xak'krixis", "identity": "monster:MONS_XAKKRIXIS", "unique_title": "王家远征炼金师扎克里西斯\n", "zh": "扎克里西斯"}] 生命周期：current definition; ordinary/help/internal according to snapshot flags | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monsters.txt:600；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monsters.txt:3153；{"boundary": "Per-identity EN/ZH propositions read above; YAMLcore facts and selected book/producer evidence below. | monster-body:zenata | <br>A master weaponsmith, her flesh melding into steel so smoothly that it's hard to<br>tell where one ends and the other begins. She entered the Dungeon to search for<br>the secrets of an ancient, long-suppressed cult, said to have exalted metal over<br>flesh. The price of knowledge was her humanity - a price she paid eagerly. | <br>一位武器锻造大师，她的身体与钢铁融为一体，<br>以至于很难分清哪块是肉，哪块是钢铁。<br>她进入地牢是为了探寻一个古老的、长期被压制的邪教的秘密，<br>据说这个邪教推崇金属胜于肉体。知识的代价是她的人性——这是她热切付出的代价。 | keep | 武器大师肉钢难分、入地牢寻被压旧金属胜肉教、热切以人性付知识价齐全。 生产入口："YAMLname -&gt; generatedmondata/get_monster_data -&gt; mon-info.cc:1092 db_name -&gt; describe.cc:7834/7846. | monster-body:zin angel | <br>A divine agent of Zin. It is a towering winged figure with an aura of brilliant<br>white light. Its face is marked by a scowl, as if its zeal against any real or<br>perceived vice overshadows its goodness. | <br>辛的神圣使者。它身形高大，长着翅膀，周身环绕着璀璨的白色光环。<br>它的脸上带着怒容，仿佛对确有其事或臆想的罪恶的狂热，已经盖过了自身的善意。 | adjust | towering winged figure是高大有翼身影，非高耸翅膀（同angel）；real or perceived vice是确有或自以为有的罪恶，非现实和察觉到的恶。改“高大有翼的身影…对真实或臆想罪恶的狂热压过善意”。 MON-191 已修复：towering winged figure是高大有翼身影，非高耸翅膀（同angel）；real or perceived vice是确有或自以为有的罪恶，非现实和察觉到的恶。改“高大有翼的身影…对真实或臆想罪恶的狂热压过善意”。 生产入口："dat/des/altar/overflow.des:5578,6254,6279,6310; dat/des/branches/zot.des:4175" 生命周期：current explicit dbname | crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/monsters.txt:3976；crawl-ref/source/dat/descript/zh/monsters.txt:2971；{"boundary": "Per-identity EN/ZH propositions read above; YAMLcore facts and selected book/producer evidence below. ### 覆盖与后续边界

通用怪物法术/状态/装备、随机名词库及对白不由此750身份替代；其他批次的证据按各自边界复用。本节新增代码由独立代码审查及统一profile验证，文字复核覆盖所有75确认问题及71篇变化正文，不声称第二次独立重读全部750卡。
